chapter.name: Moksha Sannyasa Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna explains the true meaning of renunciation (sannyasa) and detachment (tyaga), and how performing one's duty without attachment leads to liberation.
chapter.theme: Renunciation, duty, knowledge, and the path to ultimate liberation
chapter.yogaType: Jnana and Karma Yoga - Synthesis of Knowledge and Action

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् | त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam icchāmi veditum | tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthak keśini-sūdana ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: O mighty-armed Krishna, I wish to understand renunciation and detachment separately.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः | सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ sannyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ | sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṃ prāhus tyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Krishna said: Renunciation is giving up selfish actions; detachment is giving up their fruits.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः | यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे ||
verses.transliteration: tyājyaṃ doṣavad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ | yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti cāpare ||
verses.english_translation: Some say action should be renounced; others say sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be abandoned.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम | त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः ||
verses.transliteration: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama | tyāgo hi puruṣa-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Listen to My conclusion: renunciation is of three kinds.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् | यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ||
verses.transliteration: yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṃ kāryam eva tat | yajño dānaṃ tapaś caiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām ||
verses.english_translation: Sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be given up.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च | कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् ||
verses.transliteration: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca | kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matam uttamam ||
verses.english_translation: These actions must be performed without attachment to results.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते | मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ||
verses.transliteration: niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate | mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Abandoning duty out of ignorance is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् | स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ||
verses.transliteration: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśa-bhayāt tyajet | sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāga-phalaṃ labhet ||
verses.english_translation: Giving up action due to fear or discomfort is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन | सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ||
verses.transliteration: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṃ kriyate 'rjuna | saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Performing duty without attachment is Sattvic renunciation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते | त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ||
verses.transliteration: na dveṣṭy akuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate | tyāgī sattva-samāviṣṭo medhāvī chinna-saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The wise neither hate unpleasant work nor cling to pleasant work.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः | यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते ||
verses.transliteration: na hi deha-bhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇy aśeṣataḥ | yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate ||
verses.english_translation: It is impossible to give up all actions; one must renounce their results.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् | भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् ||
verses.transliteration: aniṣṭam iṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca tri-vidhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam | bhavaty atyāgināṃ pretya na tu sannyāsināṃ kvacit ||
verses.english_translation: Results of actions are threefold, but not for those who renounce.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे | सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ||
verses.transliteration: pañcaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me | sāṅkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām ||
verses.english_translation: Learn the five causes of action as described in philosophy.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् | विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ||
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthag-vidham | vividhāś ca pṛthak ceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam ||
verses.english_translation: The five causes are body, doer, instruments, effort, and divine factor.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः | न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ||
verses.transliteration: śarīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ | nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Whatever action one performs has these five causes.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः | पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ||
verses.transliteration: tatraivaṃ sati kartāram ātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ | paśyaty akṛta-buddhitvān na sa paśyati durmatiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who thinks the self alone is the doer lacks understanding.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यस्य नाहङ्कृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते | हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate | hatvā 'pi sa imāṃl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate ||
verses.english_translation: One free from ego is not bound even while acting.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना | करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः ||
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-codanā | karaṇaṃ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Knowledge, the object, and the knower motivate action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः | प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि ||
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ | procyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvac chṛṇu tāny api ||
verses.english_translation: Knowledge, action, and the doer are classified by the three gunas.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते | अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-bhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvam avyayam īkṣate | avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu taj jñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing one undivided reality in all beings is Sattvic knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् | वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ||
verses.transliteration: pṛthaktvena tu yaj jñānaṃ nānā-bhāvān pṛthag-vidhān | vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu taj jñānaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
verses.english_translation: Seeing diversity without unity is Rajasic knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् | अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: yat tu kṛtsnavad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam | atattvārtha-vad alpaṃ ca tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Clinging to one idea without reason is Tamasic knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् | अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: niyataṃ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣataḥ kṛtam | aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Duty done without attachment is Sattvic action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः | क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ | kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tad rājasaṃ udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Action driven by desire or ego is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् | मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsām anapekṣya ca pauruṣam | मोहाद आरभ्यते कर्म यत् तत् तामसम् उच्यते ||
verses.english_translation: Action done in ignorance without considering consequences is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः | सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: mukta-saṅgo 'nahaṃ-vādī dhṛty-utsāha-samanvitaḥ | siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: A doer free from ego and steady in success and failure is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः | हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ||
verses.transliteration: rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hiṃsātmako 'śuciḥ | harṣa-śokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: A doer attached to results and emotions is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः | विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko 'lasaḥ | viṣādī dīrgha-sūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: A lazy, deceitful, and unsteady doer is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु | प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय ||
verses.transliteration: buddher bhedaṃ dhṛteś caiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṃ śṛṇu | procyamānam aśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanañjaya ||
verses.english_translation: Now hear the threefold divisions of intellect and determination.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये | बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ||
verses.transliteration: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye | bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
verses.english_translation: The intellect that understands right and wrong is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च | अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ||
verses.transliteration: yayā dharmam adharmam ca kāryam cākāryam eva ca | ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
verses.english_translation: Intellect that cannot distinguish right from wrong is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता | सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ||
verses.transliteration: adharmam dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā | sarvārthān viparītāṃś ca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
verses.english_translation: Intellect that sees wrong as right is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः | योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ||
verses.transliteration: dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ | yogena avyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
verses.english_translation: Steadfast determination that controls mind and senses is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन | प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ||
verses.transliteration: yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛtyā dhārayate 'rjuna | prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
verses.english_translation: Determination driven by desire for results is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च | न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा तामसी मता ||
verses.transliteration: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madam eva ca | na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā tāmasī matā ||
verses.english_translation: Foolish determination bound by fear and sorrow is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सुखं तु तद्विजानीयात्त्रिविधं शृणु मेऽर्जुन | अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: sukhaṃ tu tad vijānīyāt tri-vidhaṃ śṛṇu me 'rjuna | abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati ||
verses.english_translation: Happiness is also threefold; listen carefully.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् | तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ||
verses.transliteration: yat tad agre viṣam iva pariṇāme 'mṛtopamam | tat sukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam ||
verses.english_translation: Sattvic happiness is bitter at first but sweet later.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् | परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: viṣayendriya-saṃyogād yat tad agre 'mṛtopamam | pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Rajasic happiness feels sweet initially but painful later.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः | निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: yad agre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanam ātmanaḥ | nidrā-lāsya-pramādotthaṃ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Tamasic happiness arises from sleep, laziness, and delusion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः | सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ||
verses.transliteration: na tad asti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ | sattvaṃ prakṛti-jair muktaṃ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: No being is free from the three gunas born of nature.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप | कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ||
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa-kṣatriya-viśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa | karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Duties are divided according to nature and qualities.
verses.meaning: Work depends on nature, not birth alone.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च | ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ||
verses.transliteration: śamo damas tapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntir ārjavam eva ca | jñānaṃ vijñānam āstikyaṃ brahma-karma svabhāvajam ||
verses.english_translation: Calmness, self-control, purity, and knowledge are Brahminical duties.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् | दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ||
verses.transliteration: śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtir dākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpy apalāyanam | dānam īśvara-bhāvaś ca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam ||
verses.english_translation: Valor, strength, courage, and leadership are Kshatriya duties.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् | परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ||
verses.transliteration: kṛṣi-gau-rakṣya-vāṇijyaṃ vaiśya-karma svabhāvajam | paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam ||
verses.english_translation: Agriculture, trade, and service are natural duties of different groups.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः | स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ||
verses.transliteration: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ | sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tac chṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: By performing one's own duty, one attains perfection.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् | स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ||
verses.transliteration: yataḥ pravṛttir bhūtānāṃ yena sarvam idaṃ tatam | sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The Lord is the source of all beings; by worshipping Him through duty, one attains perfection.
verses.meaning: God is the origin of all action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् | स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ||
verses.transliteration: śreyān sva-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt svanuṣṭhitāt | svabhāva-niyataṃ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam ||
verses.english_translation: Better is one's own duty even if imperfect than another’s duty.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् | सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ||
verses.transliteration: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣam api na tyajet | sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛtāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One should not abandon natural duty even if imperfect.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः | नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛhaḥ | naiṣkarmya-siddhiṃ paramāṃ sannyāsenādhigacchati ||
verses.english_translation: One free from attachment attains supreme perfection.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे | समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ||
verses.transliteration: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me | samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||
verses.english_translation: The highest knowledge leads one to Brahman.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च | शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ||
verses.transliteration: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca | śabdādīn viṣayāṃs tyaktvā rāga-dveṣau vyudasya ca ||
verses.english_translation: With purified intellect and self-control, one gives up attraction and hatred.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः | ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ||
verses.transliteration: vivikta-sevī laghv-āśī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ | dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Living in solitude, eating moderately, and practicing meditation leads to peace.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् | विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ||
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham | vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate ||
verses.english_translation: Giving up ego, anger, and desire leads to Brahman realization.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति | समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ||
verses.transliteration: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasanna-ātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati | samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu mad-bhaktiṃ labhate parām ||
verses.english_translation: One who is self-realized is peaceful and attains supreme devotion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः | ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ||
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaś cāsmi tattvataḥ | tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tad anantaram ||
verses.english_translation: Through devotion, one truly understands Me and enters Me.
verses.meaning: Devotion leads to union with God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः | मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśrayaḥ | mat-prasādād avāpnoti śāśvataṃ padam avyayam ||
verses.english_translation: By surrendering all actions to Me, one attains the eternal state.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः | बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ||
verses.transliteration: cetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ | buddhi-yogam upāśritya mac-cittaḥ satataṃ bhava ||
verses.english_translation: Offer all actions to Me and keep your mind fixed on Me.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि | अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ||
verses.transliteration: mac-cittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣyasi | atha cet tvam ahaṅkārān na śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi ||
verses.english_translation: By remembering Me, you will overcome all difficulties.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे | मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ||
verses.transliteration: yad ahaṅkāram āśritya na yotsya iti manyase | mithyaiṣa vyavasāyas te prakṛtis tvāṃ niyokṣyati ||
verses.english_translation: If you think you will not act out of ego, your nature will compel you.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा | कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत् ||
verses.transliteration: svabhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā | kartuṃ necchasi yan mohāt kariṣyasy avaśo 'pi tat ||
verses.english_translation: You are bound by your nature; even unwillingly you will act.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति | भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ||
verses.transliteration: īśvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ hṛd-deśe 'rjuna tiṣṭhati | bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantra-rūḍhāni māyayā ||
verses.english_translation: The Lord resides in the hearts of all beings and directs them like machines by His power.
verses.meaning: Divine control exists within all beings.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत | तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ||
verses.transliteration: tam eva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarva-bhāvena bhārata | tat prasādāt parāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ||
verses.english_translation: Surrender completely to Him; by His grace you will attain eternal peace.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया | विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ||
verses.transliteration: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ mayā | vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
verses.english_translation: Thus I have explained the most secret knowledge; now reflect and act as you wish.
verses.meaning: Freedom of choice is given after wisdom.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः | इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-guhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | iṣṭo 'si me dṛḍham iti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam ||
verses.english_translation: Hear My most confidential instruction again for your welfare.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु | मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ||
verses.transliteration: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṃ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo 'si me ||
verses.english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, become My devotee, worship Me, and you will come to Me.
verses.meaning: Devotion is the direct path to God.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज | अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ahaṃ tvāṃ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Abandon all duties and surrender unto Me alone; I will liberate you.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन | न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ||
verses.transliteration: idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana | na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo 'bhyasūyati ||
verses.english_translation: This knowledge should not be given to the non-devotional or disrespectful.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति | भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ||
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ mad-bhakteṣv abhidhāsyati | bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā mām evaiṣyaty asaṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who teaches this supreme secret with devotion reaches Me.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः | भव्यते च न मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ||
verses.transliteration: na ca tasmān manuṣyeṣu kaścin me priya-kṛttamaḥ | bhavaty e ca na me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ||
verses.english_translation: No one is dearer to Me than one who shares this knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः | ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः ||
verses.transliteration: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādam āvayoḥ | jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who studies this dialogue worships Me through knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः | सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ||
verses.transliteration: śraddhāvān anasūyaś ca śṛṇuyād api yo naraḥ | so 'pi muktaḥ śubhān lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām ||
verses.english_translation: Even one who hears with faith attains liberation and good worlds.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा | कच्चिदज्ञानसम्मोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय ||
verses.transliteration: kaccid etac chrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā | kaccid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣṭas te dhanañjaya ||
verses.english_translation: O Arjuna, has your confusion been destroyed after hearing this?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत | स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayācyuta | sthito 'smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: My illusion is gone; I will act according to Your words.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच | इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः | संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ||
verses.transliteration: sañjaya uvāca | ity ahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ | saṃvādam imam aśrauṣam adbhutaṃ roma-harṣaṇam ||
verses.english_translation: Sanjaya said: I heard this divine and wondrous dialogue.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् | योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ||
verses.transliteration: vyāsa-prasādāc chrutavān etad guhyam ahaṃ param | yogaṃ yogeśvarāt kṛṣṇāt sākṣāt kathayataḥ svayam ||
verses.english_translation: By Vyasa’s grace I heard this secret from Krishna himself.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् | केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ||
verses.transliteration: rājan saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādam imam adbhutam | keśava-arjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhur muhuḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Remembering this sacred dialogue, I rejoice again and again.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः | विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ||
verses.transliteration: tac ca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpam atyadbhutaṃ hareḥ | vismayo me mahān rājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Remembering Krishna’s divine form, I am filled with wonder.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः | तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ||
verses.transliteration: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ | tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama ||
verses.english_translation: Wherever Krishna and Arjuna are, there is victory, prosperity, and righteousness.
